All unit tests pass. Now the transport (open/send/recv/close) and storage (store/load/unlink) tests — these are the most intricate parts. Let me write them, thinking carefully about the semantics:

**open**: 
- id must not be open; gen must exceed the last successful open gen for that id (even after close); connections capacity.

**send**:
- source context + exact open connection; stream > mark; destination registered; packets capacity; wire output; source unchanged; denied contexts may be sent.

**recv**:
- packet on exact connection; unit live+exact; unit service == destination; wire check; first delivery creates a context + receipt + raises mark; duplicates.

**close**: removes connection + packets + receipts, releases refs.

**store/load/unlink**: file generations, overwrite, refs.

Let me write these tests.

cat > /workspace/tests/t_transport.py <<'PYEOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
from run import *

OK = {'ok': True}
REJ = {'error': 'rejected'}
SEV = {'op': 'stage', 'epoch': 1, 'policy': 'match(A,B) allow;'}
STAGE = {'ok': True, 'epoch': 1, 'image': {'accept': [False, False, True],
         'rows': [[1, 4294967295], [4294967295, 2], [4294967295, 4294967295]]}}
SETUP = [SEV, {'op': 'commit', 'epoch': 1},
         {'op': 'spawn', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'service': 'A'},
         {'op': 'spawn', 'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'service': 'B'},
         {'op': 'begin', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1},
         {'op': 'open', 'connection': [1, 1]}]
SETUP_OK = [STAGE, OK, OK, OK, {'ok': True, 'epoch': 1, 'state': 1}, OK]
SEND = {'op': 'send', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1, 'connection': [1, 1],
        'stream': 1, 'destination': 'B'}
WIRE1 = '454d43340000000100000001000000020000000100000001'
RECV = {'op': 'recv', 'connection': [1, 1], 'stream': 1, 'unit': [0, 2, 1],
        'rid': 1, 'wire': None}

case('open generation rules survive close', [
    {'op': 'open', 'connection': [1, 1]},
    {'op': 'open', 'connection': [1, 1]},
    {'op': 'open', 'connection': [1, 1], },
    {'op': 'close', 'connection': [1, 1]},
    {'op': 'open', 'connection': [1, 1]},
    {'op': 'open', 'connection': [1, 2]},
    {'op': 'open', 'connection': [2, 1]},
], [OK, REJ, REJ, OK, REJ, OK, OK])

case('connection capacity', [
    {'op': 'open', 'connection': [1, 1]},
    {'op': 'open', 'connection': [2, 1]},
    {'op': 'open', 'connection': [3, 1]},
], [OK, OK, REJ],
    limits={'images': 16, 'cells': 262144, 'units': 1024, 'contexts': 32768,
            'connections': 2, 'packets': 32768, 'files': 8192})

case('send preconditions', SETUP + [
    {'op': 'send', 'unit': [0, 1, 2], 'rid': 1, 'connection': [1, 1], 'stream': 1, 'destination': 'B'},
    {'op': 'send', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 2, 'connection': [1, 1], 'stream': 1, 'destination': 'B'},
    {'op': 'send', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1, 'connection': [1, 2], 'stream': 1, 'destination': 'B'},
    {'op': 'send', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1, 'connection': [2, 1], 'stream': 1, 'destination': 'B'},
    {'op': 'send', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1, 'connection': [1, 1], 'stream': 0, 'destination': 'B'},
    {'op': 'send', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1, 'connection': [1, 1], 'stream': 1, 'destination': 'Z'},
    SEND,
    {'op': 'send', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1, 'connection': [1, 1], 'stream': 2, 'destination': 'B'},
    {'op': 'send', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1, 'connection': [1, 1], 'stream': 3, 'destination': 'B'},
    {'op': 'inspect'},
], SETUP_OK + [REJ, REJ, REJ, REJ, REJ, REJ, {'ok': True, 'wire': WIRE1},
    {'ok': True, 'wire': '454d43340000000100000001000000020000000200000001'},
    REJ,
    {'ok': True, 'active': 1, 'images': [[1, 3, 2, 3]], 'units': 2, 'contexts': 1,
     'connections': 1, 'packets': 2, 'files': 0}],
    limits={'images': 16, 'cells': 262144, 'units': 1024, 'contexts': 32768,
            'connections': 4096, 'packets': 2, 'files': 8192})

case('stream marks are per connection', SETUP + [
    SEND,
    {'op': 'open', 'connection': [2, 1]},
    {'op': 'send', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1, 'connection': [2, 1], 'stream': 1, 'destination': 'B'},
    {'op': 'send', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1, 'connection': [1, 1], 'stream': 2, 'destination': 'B'},
], SETUP_OK + [{'ok': True, 'wire': WIRE1}, OK,
    {'ok': True, 'wire': '454d43340000000100000001000000020000000100000001'},
    {'ok': True, 'wire': '454d43340000000100000001000000020000000200000001'}])

case('recv delivers once, duplicates replay the same value', SETUP + [
    SEND,
    RECV,
    RECV,
    RECV,
    {'op': 'finish', 'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'rid': 1},
    RECV,
], SETUP_OK + [{'ok': True, 'wire': WIRE1}, {'ok': True, 'epoch': 1, 'state': 2},
    {'ok': True, 'epoch': 1, 'state': 2}, {'ok': True, 'epoch': 1, 'state': 2},
    {'ok': True, 'allow': True}, REJ])

case('recv duplicate needs the same unit identity and rid', SETUP + [
    {'op': 'spawn', 'unit': [0, 3, 1], 'service': 'B'},
    SEND,
    RECV,
    {'op': 'recv', 'connection': [1, 1], 'stream': 1, 'unit': [0, 3, 1], 'rid': 1, 'wire': None},
    {'op': 'recv', 'connection': [1, 1], 'stream': 1, 'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'rid': 2, 'wire': None},
], SETUP_OK + [OK, {'ok': True, 'wire': WIRE1}, {'ok': True, 'epoch': 1, 'state': 2},
    REJ, REJ])

case('recv first delivery raises the request mark', SETUP + [
    SEND,
    {'op': 'recv', 'connection': [1, 1], 'stream': 1, 'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'rid': 1, 'wire': None},
    {'op': 'begin', 'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'rid': 1},
    {'op': 'begin', 'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'rid': 2},
], SETUP_OK + [{'ok': True, 'wire': WIRE1}, {'ok': True, 'epoch': 1, 'state': 2},
    REJ, {'ok': True, 'epoch': 1, 'state': 1}])

case('recv requires the packet and matching service', SETUP + [
    {'op': 'recv', 'connection': [1, 1], 'stream': 1, 'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'rid': 1, 'wire': None},
    {'op': 'recv', 'connection': [2, 1], 'stream': 1, 'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'rid': 1, 'wire': None},
    SEND,
    {'op': 'recv', 'connection': [1, 1], 'stream': 2, 'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'rid': 1, 'wire': None},
    {'op': 'recv', 'connection': [1, 1], 'stream': 1, 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1, 'wire': None},
    {'op': 'recv', 'connection': [1, 1], 'stream': 1, 'unit': [0, 9, 1], 'rid': 1, 'wire': None},
], SETUP_OK + [REJ, REJ, {'ok': True, 'wire': WIRE1}, REJ, REJ, REJ])

case('recv explicit wire must be the 48 hex characters of the packet', SETUP + [
    SEND,
    {'op': 'recv', 'connection': [1, 1], 'stream': 1, 'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'rid': 1, 'wire': WIRE1},
    {'op': 'recv', 'connection': [1, 1], 'stream': 1, 'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'rid': 2, 'wire': WIRE1.upper()},
    {'op': 'recv', 'connection': [1, 1], 'stream': 1, 'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'rid': 3, 'wire': '454d4334'},
    {'op': 'recv', 'connection': [1, 1], 'stream': 1, 'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'rid': 4, 'wire': WIRE1[:-1]},
    {'op': 'recv', 'connection': [1, 1], 'stream': 1, 'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'rid': 5, 'wire': '00' + WIRE1[2:]},
    {'op': 'inspect'},
], SETUP_OK + [{'ok': True, 'wire': WIRE1}, {'ok': True, 'epoch': 1, 'state': 2},
    REJ, REJ, REJ, REJ,
    {'ok': True, 'active': 1, 'images': [[1, 3, 2, 2]], 'units': 2, 'contexts': 1,
     'connections': 1, 'packets': 1, 'files': 0}])

case('close removes packets and receipts, keeping receiver contexts', SETUP + [
    SEND,
    RECV,
    {'op': 'inspect'},
    {'op': 'close', 'connection': [1, 1]},
    {'op': 'inspect'},
    RECV,
    {'op': 'close', 'connection': [1, 1]},
], SETUP_OK + [{'ok': True, 'wire': WIRE1}, {'ok': True, 'epoch': 1, 'state': 2},
    {'ok': True, 'active': 1, 'images': [[1, 3, 2, 2]], 'units': 2, 'contexts': 2,
     'connections': 1, 'packets': 1, 'files': 0},
    OK,
    {'ok': True, 'active': 1, 'images': [[1, 3, 2, 1]], 'units': 2, 'contexts': 2,
     'connections': 0, 'packets': 0, 'files': 0},
    REJ, REJ])

case('packets capacity counts retained packets', SETUP + [
    SEND,
    RECV,
    {'op': 'open', 'connection': [2, 1]},
    {'op': 'send', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1, 'connection': [2, 1], 'stream': 1, 'destination': 'B'},
], SETUP_OK + [{'ok': True, 'wire': WIRE1}, {'ok': True, 'epoch': 1, 'state': 2}, OK, REJ],
    limits={'images': 16, 'cells': 262144, 'units': 1024, 'contexts': 32768,
            'connections': 4096, 'packets': 1, 'files': 8192})

case('denied contexts may be sent', [
    {'op': 'stage', 'epoch': 1, 'policy': 'match(A,B) allow;'},
    {'op': 'commit', 'epoch': 1},
    {'op': 'spawn', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'service': 'B'},
    {'op': 'spawn', 'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'service': 'A'},
    {'op': 'begin', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1},
    {'op': 'open', 'connection': [1, 1]},
    {'op': 'send', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1, 'connection': [1, 1], 'stream': 1, 'destination': 'A'},
    {'op': 'recv', 'connection': [1, 1], 'stream': 1, 'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'rid': 1, 'wire': None},
    {'op': 'finish', 'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'rid': 1},
], [STAGE, OK, OK, OK, {'ok': True, 'epoch': 1, 'state': 4294967295}, OK,
    {'ok': True, 'wire': '454d433400000001ffffffff000000010000000100000001'},
    {'ok': True, 'epoch': 1, 'state': 1},
    {'ok': True, 'allow': False}])

sys.exit(summary())
PYEOF
